svg.text: VLA v499 — one clock tick (40 ms): recurrent CNN with recall attention as its only state

n_hidden 512 · c_context 384 · 7×7 grid · depth 8 · 3 token streams · 25 Hz · no registers · ring emptied at each example · 20.3M trainable · state 100,352 ring values · image / audio encoders: future
each stream's sample → its next input (training: the dataset's)
k = K·e (no age) · v = V·e + V′·e_next
recall attention: entry write, MQA read
ring of W = 1024 entries: the whole state, emptied per example
media input: video frame (2 Hz), sound (16 kHz)
